title: CrowdStrike fiscal Q1 2027 Form 10-Q
excerpt: At April 30, 2026 CrowdStrike reported USD 4.553 billion of cash, USD 745.8 million of long-term debt and USD 590.9 million of quarterly operating cash flow.
summary: The unchanged fiscal Q1 Form 10-Q remains the latest periodic operating filing and continues to support the retained balance-sheet, cash-flow, stock-compensation, dilution and incident-risk assumptions.
